Step 1 of 3 · Reason & final read

Why is it coming out?

The final read closes the meter's billing life. Without it the last cycle cannot be billed.

Retiring, not deleting
Referenced by reads and bills, so it can't be deleted. Retiring keeps the history and removes it from active lists.
LAST CYCLE
Usage since Aug 3: 48 kWh · roughly $12.24. This will appear on the August bill.
 Step 2 of 3 · Replacement

What takes its place?

A unit with no meter cannot be billed. Assign the replacement now or the account goes to estimated reads.

WARNING
Leaving Unit A unmetered puts account A-10432 onto estimated billing from the next cycle.

Step 1 of 5 · Trigger

When does this rule fire?

A rule watches one event and acts every time it happens — no one has to notice it first.

SOURCE
Matches both rule-raised orders (dunning, certification calendar) and manually created ones.
 Step 2 of 5 · Assignment logic

Who gets the job — decided in order.

The system tries each strategy top to bottom and stops at the first that finds someone. Drag to reorder.

⠿ 1 Area / sub-area routing
The technician who owns the order route — D. Ortiz owns Route 2, Downtown
⠿ 2 Skill match
Only technicians holding the template skills — Disconnect requires Water II
⠿ 3 Load balancing
Among qualified techs, the one with the fewest jobs today
FALLBACK If every strategy fails, the order lands in the dispatch queue for a human — never silently unassigned.
Step 3 of 5 · Notifications

Who hears about it, and how.

Three audiences, each with their own channels. Untick a row to silence it.

Consumer
Technician
Supervisor
Step 4 of 5 · Reminders & escalation

What happens when nothing happens.

Each rung fires only if the one above did not resolve it. This ladder is why no order sits forgotten.

IfAfterThen
1Not accepted by technician30 minRe-offer to next match in the strategy order
2Not started by window open15 minNotify supervisor · SMS reminder to technician
3SLA at 80%—Escalate to dispatcher · re-prioritise to Urgent
4SLA breached—Flag on Performance · notify Owner · log for the regulator packet
Step 5 of 5 · Review & activate

The rule, in one sentence.

Simulated against last month so you know what it would have done before it does anything.

When a Disconnect — non-payment order is created in any area: assign by route → skill → load (fallback: dispatch queue); text the customer a window and an ETA; push the packet to the technician; re-offer after 30 min, escalate at 80% SLA.

Step 1 of 4 · Identity

What is it, and what is it called?

The asset number is how field crews and imports will find it. It has to be unique.

UNIQUE
M-5101 is available. Numbers already in use are rejected at save, and by the importer.
 Step 2 of 4 · Specification

The numbers that affect billing.

Get the multiplier wrong and every bill from this meter is wrong. It is the single most consequential field here.

MULTIPLIER
A ×10 meter reading 4,286 means 42,860 units. Confirm against the meter face before saving.
 Step 3 of 4 · Assignment

Where does it go?

Leave it unassigned and it sits in inventory until a technician installs it.

INVENTORY
Unassigned assets show on the Inventory tab and are visible to dispatch when scheduling an exchange.
